== Summary ==
[[Jared Napolitano]] (3rd place) with his crystal award in front of the Players Committee banner. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Identified by matching his face (round face, full dark beard, eyebrows, smile) to his place in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] (top left; wrap-up caption). He wears a light-blue cap and T-shirt here rather than the polo shirt of the group photo, so the match rests on the face; best judgement.

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
